low.name: Low Tier (Fast / Budget)
low.description: Fast and cheap model for trivial checks, simple filtering, and fast classifications.

medium_low.name: Medium-Low Tier (Light Worker)
medium_low.description: Lightweight model for routine summarization, basic extraction, and small helper workers.

medium.name: Medium Tier (Balanced Everyday)
medium.description: Balanced everyday model for standard conversation and regular background tasks.

high.name: High Tier (Advanced Reasoning & Coding)
high.description: High-capability model for deep research, data analysis, and complex coding.

very_high.name: Very High Tier (World-Class / Flagship)
very_high.description: The best model in the world for critical software architecture, self-editing, and tough debugging.
